decisions.title: The hub runs on LiteLLM, Mem0, Open WebUI, Postgres and one custom service
Classifier and embedding switch automatically; chat routes wait for approval
The Omen is the workstation; msi-ai1 is the control point
Documents become text on the box: MarkItDown, Anydoc fallback
OmniRoute supplies its free-tier catalogue, nothing else
Free external judges wait for Dallin's word
Mail comes through Spark on the Omen; the hub never sends
Follow the model-agnostic outline's file discipline, not its path
Our own machines over Tailscale are inside the private boundary
A local, swappable Jev-style decision layer; paid Jev later, never for private requests
Fixed local groups name measured tags that fit the card; the LiteLLM config stays a file
Free external models may answer non-private work; keys and paid tiers wait for Dallin
Paid tools stay in the routes and are used only when there is a way to pay
Connections is the registry of vendors, keys and core components; keys pasted on the page land in ~/hub/.env
A 30%+ winner with the same cost and speed is chosen automatically; the rest are summaries with choices; resources count (one quality point per 5% less GPU work, amended 2026-10-04)
One 16384-token context window for every local model call; Ollama's default silently cut long prompts
Every automated call has a ceiling, each layer a little above the one below, and a call that runs out says so by name
